text_block_list.text:
One day, while training
with Katsuragi Ace—

...Lately, Katsuragi Ace has been showing
signs of deep fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Mmm, nothing hurts or feels especially bad, but lately it feels like it's gotten a wee bit harder to shake off fatigue...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm able to eat, but still...
Hmmmm...

"Perhaps the fatigue from running
the Classic Triple Crown route
is still lingering within her...?"
choice_data_list: Maybe we should hold off on entering races for the rest of the month.

text_block_list.text: For the sake of challenging the Senior year next year, it wouldn't hurt to play it safe for now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah!
I don't wanna rush now and ruin next year.
Let's be careful and focus on what we can do right now!
—And so, we decided to refrain from entering any races for the rest of the month, prioritizing Katsuragi Ace's recovery.
